description: This file defines the Category class in the Goteo project, including methods for retrieving, listing, and managing project categories, as well as handling related data such as social commitments and keywords.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Model class representing project categories with methods for CRUD operations, listing, and related data retrieval.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the fields used for language-specific data, namely 'name' and 'description'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its ID, optionally in a specific language.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all categories with counts of associated projects and user interests.

methods.name: getNames
methods.description: Returns an array of category names used in published projects, excluding test categories.

methods.name: getSocialCommitment
methods.description: Fetches the social commitment object associated with the category.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the category data, ensuring the 'name' field is not empty.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the category data to the database after validation.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Reorders the category to appear earlier in the list.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Reorders the category to appear later in the list.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next order number for adding a new category.

methods.name: getKeyWords
methods.description: Retrieves a list of distinct keywords from projects, optionally filtered by a search term.
